id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

auditLogKey.description: partition key of the Config.AuditLog. configType + configKey

configType.description: Type#name of the config being set

appId.description: The id of the {@link App} on which the config action is being performed

rootActionJson.description: The json of the root {@link Action} being performed

configAction.description: The config action being performed, e.g. "setConfig", "setSecretValue", "clearConfigValue"

secret.description: Whether the config action perform was for secrets

configJson.description: The secret values should be securely hashed, so that they are not stored in plain text but it can still be known if the value has changed.

title:
Config.AuditLog is used to track each change to {@link Config}s. Each Config.AuditLog contains information about the
config, the changes, and the context of the operation (user, app, action, etc).
name: Config.AuditLog
